title: Clingy Love
premise: A neon pixel arcade game where two romantic partners move as a linked pair and must alternate between hugging together and splitting apart to survive incoming hazards and collect hearts.
interaction_model: One-button hold-and-release control. Hold mouse or touch to collapse the pair into the center lane; release to separate them into upper and lower lanes while the world scrolls toward them automatically.
objective: Survive as long as possible and increase score by reading obstacle patterns, choosing the correct pair formation, and collecting hearts placed in matching lanes.
progression: Single-run arcade progression with no levels. Difficulty increases gradually through rising scroll speed, sustained pattern pressure, and continued survival-based score accumulation.
theme: Romantic neon pixel melodrama with playful relationship imagery, hearts, cuddle framing, and jealous wall hazards.
mood: Cute, arcade-like, melodramatic, energetic, and lightly comedic.
likely_audience: Players who enjoy quick arcade browser games
Players drawn to cute romance-themed pixel presentation
Casual score-chasing mobile and desktop players
confidence_notes: High confidence in the core interaction because UI text and code explicitly describe hold-to-hug and release-to-split behavior.
High confidence that the game is score-based endless survival rather than level-based progression.
Moderate confidence in naming identity because the HTML title differs from the visible in-game title, but the on-screen branding strongly indicates 'Clingy Love' as the player-facing title.
High confidence that the romance framing is thematic dressing over an arcade runner-style mechanic.
recreation_prompt: Create a polished single-screen browser arcade game called 'Clingy Love' with a neon pixel-art romance theme. The player controls two tiny character sprites locked to a fixed horizontal position while the world scrolls from right to left like an endless runner. The entire game uses one binary input: hold mouse or touch to make the two characters hug together and collapse into the center lane, and release to split them apart into upper and lower lanes. Build the gameplay around reading upcoming obstacle shapes and switching between these two formations at the right moment. Use two main hazard types: a central jealous wall that punishes hugging in the middle, and a cuddle tunnel with a safe center passage that punishes staying split too wide. Add heart collectibles that appear either in the center for hugging or as top-and-bottom paired pickups for split mode, so scoring reinforces the same decision making as survival. Make the run endless with steadily increasing speed, instant-fail collision, score gain from hearts, and a simple restartable loop. Present it with a full-screen canvas, neon pink/cyan/gold colors, pixel sparkles, a silhouetted city skyline, cute heart effects, retro arcade UI cards, a compact HUD showing score and current mode, reactive pickup/fail feedback, and playful melodramatic copy like romance, heartbreak, and drama alerts. The tone should feel cute, funny, and energetic rather than serious, and it should play cleanly on both desktop and touch devices.
